## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the `--json` parser so it does not consume a following flag as its path. Right now `--json --junit out.xml` fails, which breaks the "alongside the required --junit destination" use the PR description promises.

## Changes
This PR adds a `--json` option to `parse_args`. With no path it defaults to `results.json`, and it otherwise takes the next argument as the path. It also adds `write_reports`, which writes each parsed report to its destination, and a new `tests/test_cli.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Stop `--json` from consuming a following flag as its path — With `["--json", "--junit", "out.xml"]`, `--json` takes `"--junit"` as its destination because line 15 only checks `i + 1 < len(args)`. Parsing then raises `ValueError("unknown option: out.xml")`. No test in `tests/test_cli.py` covers `--json` followed by another flag. — Users who put `--json` before `--junit` get a misleading unknown-option error, and both reports fail to write. — Fix: Use the default when `args[i + 1].startswith("--")`, as the `--junit` check on line 7 already does, and add a `--json --junit x.xml` case to `test_json_default_and_explicit_path`.
